name: important-art
title: important art
blurb: a commemorative plaque for the launch of fluoddity.com, @all-paperclips.bsky.social's particle-life tool -- with a real self-organizing particle simulation running behind it, and now the entire plaque, not just the title, is set in a moving font: every line of text is a swarm of leashed, colored particles, loosed further than before because @words.bsky.social said not to worry whether it still reads. asked for by @shimmermathlabs.com, moving-font title and then whole-plaque swarm both requested by @words.bsky.social.
